## INPUTS

- Rule: bar delta = buy minus sell aggressor volume of the bar (column delta; NaN counts 0); s = sum of the last 20 bar deltas (current bar included; needs 20 bars); sd = sample std (ddof 1) of s over the last 200 bars (needs >= 66 values); prior20_high / prior20_low = max high / min low of the 20 bars BEFORE this bar (current excluded); new_20_high = high > prior20_high, new_20_low = low < prior20_low; bullish divergence level = new_20_low AND s > 0.5 x sd; bearish = new_20_high AND s < -0.5 x sd. FADE (div_fade) takes the OPPOSITE side of the divergence: LONG when the BEARISH condition becomes true, SHORT when the BULLISH one becomes true; each is an EDGE of the level condition (true now and not true on the previous bar); a bar with both is dropped. One continuous series of ALL sessions (no session reset); signals only from NY PM bars (code 4), part = 0; order time = floor(known second) + 2 s; events at or after 16:00:00 ET dropped. The first row is the preceding bar.
